summary: Diff adds a React SPA with FBC inputs, frontend-side report generation/validation utilities, Tailwind theme styling, and also introduces Internet Identity/react-query actor scaffolding plus an empty backend actor. The required generated static image assets (logo and banner) are referenced but not present in the diff summary.

evidence: File diff summary: ADDED FILES list contains no frontend/public/assets/generated/* and no .png assets
